dress_code.men: No dress code guidelines are officially published on the temple website.
dress_code.women: No dress code guidelines are officially published on the temple website.

dos: Do keep your mind fresh and leave all your negative thoughts, stress, and pain behind.
Do open your eyes while having Darshan.
Do maintain silence inside the temple.
Do respect ancient customs and usages while in the temple premises.
Do respect and promote religious sentiments among co-pilgrims.
Do deposit your offerings and Kanukas in the Hundi only.
Do keep the temple premises clean and hygienic.
Do contact the Information Centre for unknown information about the elangana m.
Do watch your valuables very carefully (i.e., wallets, gold ornaments, luggage bags, etc.) as there is a risk of theft.
donts: Don't carry excess jewellery and cash with you.
Don't wear footwear in and around the premises of the temple.
Don't approach brokers for quick Darshan.
Don't throw away the Prasadam and Teertham given to you at the temple.
Don't carry any weapon inside the temple.
Don't smoke in and around the temple premises.
Don't wear any head guards like helmets, caps, turbans, and hats inside the temple premises.
Don't buy fake Prasadams from street vendors.
Don't commit any act of violence, harshness, anger, or jealousy in the temple premises.
Don't quarrel in the temple premises.
Don't rush in for Darshan; take your turn in the queue.
Don't encourage beggary in and around the temple premises.
Don't spit or be a nuisance inside the temple premises.
Don't carry luggage bags and other belongings inside the temple premises.
electronic_ban: Mobile phone restrictions are not officially published on the temple website.
safety_guidelines: Watch your valuables very carefully (i.e., wallets, gold ornaments, luggage bags, etc.) as there is a risk of theft.
